command_line:
set -eu
python - <<'PY'
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import zipfile

archive = pathlib.Path('/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78549895/inputs/dataset_8c0e2a96-ef92-4892-a640-78a0a65823b0.dat')
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
    z.extractall('busco_downloads')
lineage = pathlib.Path('busco_downloads/lineages/eukaryota_odb10').resolve()
required = ['dataset.cfg', 'scores_cutoff', 'lengths_cutoff', 'hmms']
missing = [name for name in required if not (lineage / name).exists()]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit('Lineage archive missing required members: ' + ', '.join(missing))

samples = [
    ('Animals_Cele', '/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78549895/inputs/dataset_4d84675d-e8f9-4f59-8609-54e0802ef963.dat'),
    ('Animals_Ggal', '/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78549895/inputs/dataset_d44e2748-2746-4b0e-b569-23b7cb8e30da.dat'),
    ('Fungi_Ncra', '/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78549895/inputs/dataset_07e64717-d9d4-4d2a-970d-0c38d0c9fb3f.dat'),
    ('Fungi_Scer', '/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78549895/inputs/dataset_0fd62599-5d0c-4c2e-a858-926793d75493.dat'),
]
threads = os.environ.get('GALAXY_SLOTS', '4')
pathlib.Path('busco_runs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for sample, seq_path in samples:
    cmd = [
        'busco',
        '-i', seq_path,
        '-m', 'proteins',
        '-l', str(lineage),
        '--offline',
        '-c', str(threads),
        '--out_path', 'busco_runs',
        '-o', sample,
    ]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)

complete_sets = {}
counts = []
for sample, seq_path in samples:
    root = pathlib.Path('busco_runs') / sample
    tables = sorted(root.glob('**/full_table*.tsv'))
    if not tables:
        raise SystemExit(f'No BUSCO full table found for {sample}')
    table = tables[0]
    complete = set()
    duplicated = set()
    fragmented = set()
    missing_ids = set()
    total_rows = 0
    with table.open() as handle:
        for line in handle:
            if not line.strip() or line.startswith('#'):
                continue
            total_rows += 1
            fields = line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
            if len(fields) < 2:
                raise SystemExit(f'Malformed BUSCO row in {table}: {line!r}')
            busco_id, status = fields[0], fields[1]
            if status == 'Complete':
                complete.add(busco_id)
            elif status == 'Duplicated':
                duplicated.add(busco_id)
            elif status == 'Fragmented':
                fragmented.add(busco_id)
            elif status == 'Missing':
                missing_ids.add(busco_id)
    complete_sets[sample] = complete
    counts.append((sample, str(table), len(complete), len(duplicated), len(fragmented), len(missing_ids), total_rows))

common = set.intersection(*(complete_sets[sample] for sample, seq_path in samples))
pathlib.Path('answer.txt').write_text(str(len(common)) + '\n')
with pathlib.Path('busco_complete_counts.tsv').open('w') as out:
    out.write('sample\ttable\tcomplete_single_copy\tduplicated\tfragmented\tmissing\ttotal_rows\n')
    for row in counts:
        out.write('\t'.join(map(str, row)) + '\n')
with pathlib.Path('common_complete_busco_ids.tsv').open('w') as out:
    out.write('busco_id\n')
    for busco_id in sorted(common):
        out.write(busco_id + '\n')
PY
